missionPremise: The operator asked for more digging, more planning and deeper review before the 2026-09-16 Texas scale-up program scope and farm architecture drafts become a plan. Five read-only research lanes (L-A ledger truth, L-B envelope unlock, L-C blocker history, L-D farm architecture, L-E customer experience) were dispatched to answer what those two draft documents could not, so the drafts can be revised from measurement rather than assumption before a final adversarial teardown attacks the revised versions.
completionPredicate: All five lane dispatches were compiled via scripts/dispatch.mjs and pasted into their sub-agents in full; all five lanes claimed their lane, ran, and released; all five filed CP1, CP2, a report, and a close JSON with pre-registered falsifiers scored against live data. The heavy-scan serialization rule (L-A before L-B on the atoms store) was honored, confirmed by L-B's own marker-poll record. I (the dispatch planner) independently verified at least three load-bearing claims per lane where practical: three code-level citations for L-D (PUBLISH_TARGETS, WRITER_TARGETS, CONSTRAINT_SEARCH_COUNTIES, all read directly at origin/main and matching exactly); L-A's two headline figures (490,185 and ~318,000) plus a row-for-row file cross-check of the per-city setback table against the program scope document I had already read; L-B's central isMachineVerifyDiagnostic mechanism, read directly at origin/main and matching exactly; a live, independent Smart Site MCP call on L-E's own Bastrop control parcel, corroborating the general defect shape (MCP withholds correctly, map/PE surface leaks) that both L-E and L-B independently found; and existence checks on L-C's cited source paths before it ran. This predicate is met. What keeps this wave closed-partial rather than closed: two of five lanes (L-B, L-C) closed themselves as closed-partial with named, real gaps (L-C's unswept 57-file session window; L-B's nonexistent negative control and un-executed live-derive test); and a process-compliance violation (section 1 of the wave report) occurred in two lanes that this close does not paper over.
scopeBasis: Dispatch planner (topology: _decisions/2026-09-11_overseer_dispatch_planner_lane_topology.md), seat dispatch-planner, worktree P:/seat-worktrees/dispatch-planner/doc_repo, branch seat/dispatch-planner. Compiled five lane dispatches, spawned five sub-agents (one level deep, as the wave dispatch requires), supervised each to completion, independently re-derived numbers and code citations from at least three claims per lane where practical, and wrote this close and the accompanying wave report. Nothing in this wave wrote to any product repo or any store; every lane's own constraintsHonored/scopeBasis fields confirm the same for their own work.
falsifier: The wave's own standard was 'exhaust the question, and a lane that finds one blocker keeps going' -- applied here to the dispatch planner's own supervisory role. Falsifier: did any lane stop at its first finding? No -- L-A found and fully reported a fifth, unscoped finding (the parcel-record-slate divergence) beyond its four pre-registered falsifiers; L-B found and fully reported the negative-control gap and the 785-vs-654 correction beyond its three; L-C grew its register through three folds rather than closing on the first; L-D named three preconditions beyond simply confirming the draft's lean; L-E graded 24 of 39 buckets and named all 15 it could not, rather than silently narrowing scope. Falsifier for my own re-derivation duty: did I independently verify claims for every lane, not just accept self-reports? Yes for all five, at varying depth (deepest for L-D and L-A, given their more directly falsifiable code/file claims; lighter for L-C given the scale of a 361-instance historical register, offset by checking its source-path existence and its own internal cross-checking discipline).
contradicted: Six items, detailed in wave report section 3: the farm architecture draft's Option B description is not a symmetric extension across the two stores (L-D); the draft never named the actual structural blocker to parallel farms, the frozen PUBLISH_TARGETS/WRITER_TARGETS enum (L-D); the scope document's 654-distinct-reason-strings figure is wrong, measured 785 (L-B); the scope document's 490,185 no-buildable-area figure is correctly six-county-scoped but is not the store-wide total, which is 848,381 plus an unmentioned third outcome class of 559,084 (L-A); the P-249 'shortest path' premise is real but the actual missing piece is a structural signal wiring gap, narrower and more specific than the dispatch's framing, and weakened by the finding that no real verified-promoted negative control exists in production (L-B); Burnet's stated selection rationale ('borders the six and is in none of them') does not hold as literally worded -- it borders 2 of 6 (L-C).
